$description: Startup Warm preset — friendly, approachable palette with a coral primary and warm neutrals. Suitable for consumer apps, onboarding flows, and creative tools. It sets all 69 colour slots and all 27 chart slots from one brand recipe (light roles and charts) over brand A's light theme; every other slot starts from brand A. Load it as a starting point with brand.intake (action "template", from { "preset": "startup-warm" }), then validate and create the brand. Brand-relative: no color.brand.<id> wrapper, so it serves any brand.
